### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

### Cisco Cloud Control

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

[Discover Cisco Cloud Control][29]
[AI Canvas London Network Troubleshooting results]

### Enterprise operations at agentic AI speed

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute
complex workflows at machine speed—while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

[Discover AI Canvas][30]
[AI networking]

### Resilient, high-speed AI networking

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]
[Cisco Silicon One processor on a circuit board in shades of blue and grey]

### Silicon to power AI-scale networking

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

### Distributed, optimized enforcement

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]
[Cisco IQ Assets Overview dashboard featuring a total assets count, coverage percentage, and AI
Assistant messages]

### Cisco IQ

Cisco IQ is the unified AI-powered experience that delivers real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]
[glow background]

Modernize and transform your data centers to power traditional and AI workloads anywhere—with speed,

Create agile, resilient workplaces that evolve with employee needs and deliver incredible customer

Keep your organization securely up and running in the face of any disruption—from cyberattacks to

# Big events come with big opportunities

Scale premium offerings with differentiated connectivity
[Discover how the game is changing][211]

## Highlights

[[""]][212]
Jul 14, 2026 | Press release

#### [Ericsson releases its Q2 2026 financial report][213]

Ericsson’s Q2 results underscore the strength of its portfolio and disciplined execution, with a
48.4% adjusted gross margin and a strong net cash position. Read the full report.

[[""]][214]
Jun 30, 2026 | Topic

#### [Your guide to differentiated connectivity][215]

Explore the Differentiated Connectivity Handbook – a practical guide to design, launch, and scale
profitable 5G services.

[[""]][216]
May 18, 2026

#### [Ericsson ranked #2 among Europe's top innovators][217]

Fortune's 2026 Most Innovative Companies list places Ericsson second among Europe's leading
companies driving the future of technology.

[[Ericsson Mobility Report June 2026 front cover. ]][218]

#### [Unpack the Mobility Report][219]

Webinar: hear what the latest data signals for service providers and enterprises - straight from the
team behind it.

[[""]][220]
Jun 11, 2026 | Magazine

#### [Four ways to grow your network without growing energy costs][221]

New analysis from Ericsson Research sets out four imperatives for improving energy efficiency at
scale – even with a 3.5x growth in traffic. Get the insights now.

[[""]][222]
May 11, 2026 | Blog post

#### [AI agents solving real network problems][223]

Multi-vendor agentic AI is transforming Cloud RAN troubleshooting. See how it cuts through complex
handoffs to find root causes across the full stack.

The next wave of mobile will transform businesses, unlock network value, and drive innovation.

[Explore our vision][224]

## Your industry

[Discover all industries][225]

Leading connectivity

connectivity and tailored solutions to unlock new revenue streams.

[Explore Communication service providers][226]
[Industry robots at a manufacturing plant.]
Enterprises
Accelerating innovation

Unlocking growth with communications and connectivity solutions that combine 5G, AI, and cloud for
enhanced productivity, scalability, and resilience.

[Explore enterprise solutions][227]
[Firefighter walking to a firetruck]

Advancing society

We empower the public sector through high-performing, secure, reliable and resilient connectivity
that drive digital transformation for government and mission-critical industries. Together, let's
create a future where intelligent networks empower a safer world.

[Explore public sector solutions][228]

ingenuity, the physical and the digital. At Honeywell Technologies, we make these connections real,
turning isolated intelligence into coordinated action.
[Multiple gas storage tanks are lined up, showcasing safety ladders and railings for secure access.]

## Expertise earned over a century.

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real
consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.
[A construction worker wearing a safety vest and helmet ascends a spiral staircase, emphasizing
safety on site.]

## Intelligence set in motion.

Across the globe, companies run their most critical operations on our technologies. Today, we
harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that
continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

customers already rely on, adding intelligence that learns from their operations, proposes
improvements, and acts only with their approval.

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# Delivering quality telemetry data from all types of machinery, trucks and vehicles

### Open IoT stack for CAN/CAN-FD/J1939 data logging, edge execution and cloud orchestration with
### Core, Cloud and API integration

Contact Us →

## Data logging platform for vehicles, equipment and machinery

Connect vehicle and machine data directly to business systems with a pipeline that starts on-device.
Configure can0/can1 channels, bitrate autodetect (Any passive, OBD active, J1939 active), pass/block
filters, DBC decoding and output handlers from AutoPi Cloud. Export raw and decoded streams in
formats including JSONL, CSV and MDF4, and route data to local storage or AWS S3.

AutoPi Core runs on Linux with SocketCAN, Python and SaltStack, while the Cloud API mirrors UI
capabilities for integration into your own backend and deployment

## AutoPi Cloud

Control plane for logging,
events and fleet operations.

[Contact Us][87] [Explore Docs][88] [API Reference][89]

AutoPi Cloud provides a unified control plane for channel configuration, logger lifecycle
management, decoder setup, output routing, frame listeners and event reactors - configurable
remotely per device, group or project. Templates apply repeatable configuration at fleet scale.
Cloud access is included with every AutoPi device.

CAN Bus & J1939 Logging

### Channel logging and decoder control

Configure named loggers per channel (can0/can1) with pass/block ID filters, rollover size and S3
sync interval. Select Standard (CSV/JSONL/LOG) or ASAM (MDF4) decoding per logger and import DBC
files with per-signal selection. J1939 PGN/SPN and 29-bit identifiers handled natively.

decoder: asam  |  output: mdf4  |  filter: pass
Edge Computing

### Docker and workflow hook deployment

Deploy containerized applications to devices via Cloud - versioned per project or fleet. Attach
workflow hooks (handler, converter, trigger, filter, enricher, returner) to frame listeners for
on-device event-driven processing. No hardware changes required to scale from filtering to local
inference.

hook types: handler · converter · trigger · filter · enricher · returner
Device Management

### Centralized configuration at scale

Define and apply device templates across groups or projects - covering channel config, logger setup,
output workers, upload policies and advanced settings fields. Changes propagate via SaltStack on
next device connection. Configuration is auditable and version-tracked in Cloud.

scope: device · group · project · template
OTA Updates

### Remote firmware and application rollout

Push firmware updates, base images and Docker containers to devices without physical access. Cloud
tracks rollout progress per device and supports rollback. Output worker intervals, retry counts and
sync behavior are tunable per update policy - critical for fleets spanning multiple sites and time
zones.

strategy: incremental · rollback supported · progress tracked
REST API

### Full API parity with the Cloud UI

Every Cloud operation - device config, logger setup, template application, event queries, trip
retrieval - is available via the REST API at api.autopi.io. Use the API to integrate AutoPi into
existing backends, CI/CD pipelines or infrastructure-as-code tooling. MQTT available for real-time
data streams.

api.autopi.io  |  REST + MQTT  |  UI parity
Fleet Management

### Event stream, trip correlation and diagnostics

Monitor device health, trip telemetry and the live event stream from one dashboard. Filter events by
tag and time window - including autodetect results, logger state changes and S3 sync confirmations.
Correlate CAN logging behavior with trip records and trigger targeted diagnostics for devices that
deviate from baseline.

## ÁREAS

Desde hace más de 40 años Becolve Digital ha formado parte del desarrollo y la evolución de la
industria y de las infraestructuras españolas.

### **Industria**

Desde la introducción del primer PLC, seguimos impulsando la **excelencia operativa en la
industria,** aportando soluciones tecnológicas e innovando para una producción más eficiente y
sostenible.

## SERVICIOS

Cuando la tecnología y el cómo se usa son igual de importantes.

Empoderar a personas y organizaciones requiere dotarlas de soluciones tecnológicas contrastadas y
adecuadas a sus necesidades, pero también asegurar un acompañamiento y una atención postventa útil .
El resultado es una organización más competitiva, eficiente y sostenible.

#### Soporte Técnico

Un equipo de expertos a tu disposición.

#### Ciclo de vida

Informe anual de todo tu sistema de automatización.

#### Consultoría

Te ayudamos a trazar un mapa para tus proyectos.

#### Auditoría

¿Necesitas un diagnóstico? Echemos un vistazo. O dos.

#### Desarrollos Custom

Cuéntanos qué necesitas, porque podemos hacerlo.

#### Pilotos / Demos

¿No te lo crees? ¡Te lo demostramos!

#### Workshops

Ven, mira, toca, experimenta… sin miedo a que nada explote.

#### Centro Competencias

Muestra tu musculatura. Libre de anabolizantes.

#### Formación

Formación on demand, de calendario, webinars…

#### Acompañamiento

Acompañados, llegaremos mejor a la meta.

Our Services

## SERVICES FOR CITIES

NEW  [AI Consulting & Implementation for the public sector → ai.beesmart.city][73]

bee smart city is a consultancy and software company specializing in the field of Smart City and
Smart Region development. Our team of experts is dedicated to helping cities and municipalities
worldwide in crafting and executing Smart City and Smart Region strategies as well as transformative
projects. As part of our comprehensive services, we proudly introduce the Smart City Toolbox, a
software-as-a-service application designed to streamline strategy implementation and facilitate
seamless (multi-)project management within cities and communities. Uncover the possibilities of our
services.

Our clients include numerous cities and districts that trust in our expertise in the field of smart
urban and regional development. We provide equal support to our clients in the creation,
implementation, and advancement of Smart City and Smart Region strategies and projects, alongside
efficient project and program management.

market. Our offerings include a smart city tender service for solution providers, as well as media

[ben-duchac-96DW4Pow3qI-unsplash.jpg]

Connected Cities Integrators 
Bridging the Digital Divide

[Learn More ][1]
[kiosk3.png]
[Wearing Mask in Public Transport]

We partner with local communities to help them design, implement, and fund data-driven, and
economically sustainable, technology solutions.


We strengthen under-served communities by upgrading and connecting their infrastructure, making
essential technologies and services accessible to all citizens. 

Our turnkey programs and solutions are custom designed using each individual community's unique data
assets to deliver:

• Improved public safety


• Enhanced quality of life

• Efficient operations and services


• Economic development opportunities

SOLUTIONS

We work with municipalities, utilities and mixed-use/mixed-income communities to design, develop,
finance, and implement connected technology programs.

[[002-world.png]][2]

[Community Connectivity][3]


•   Municipal fiber loops
•   Community-based fiber to the home
•   Public & Private Wi-Fi and 5G networks
 

[[026-server-6.png]][4]

[Data Monetization][5]


•  Data audit and revenue projection
•  Established data buyer ecosystem

•  Dedicated data marketing team

[[building.png]][6]

[Public Safety][7]


• Safety Operation Center
• Camera, ALPR integration
• Gunshot detection
 

[[map.png]][8]

[Citizen Engagement][9]


• Smart kiosks

• Events and Entertainment Apps
• 311 App with geo-tag photo capture
 

[[road.png]][10]

[Urban Mobility][11]


•  Traffic management
•  Road pricing / smart parking
•  Public transit tracking
 

[[city.png]][12]

[City Operations][13]


CityCentrix platform for
central management and situational

awareness between departments

Data Monetization 

Take control of a growing asset
 

Cities and towns everywhere already possess extensive, valuable datasets, with increased amounts of
data being readily available through the deployment of smart technologies. Too many cities,
especially smaller ones, unknowingly overlook the value of this existing data resource or give it
away too easily.


Our team of data experts help communities to take control and monetize their data assets. After an
initial audit to create a clear revenue projection, we build a City Data Directory to support
improved interdepartmental collaboration.


Profitable transactions can then be negotiated with our buyer ecosystem to leverage the revenue
value of the city's data assets that continue to grow year after year.


[Learn More ][16]

Bridging the Digital Divide

The “Digital Divide” is the existing gap in public access to information and communication
technology (ICT).  Most ICT companies across the United States prefer to service more affluent
communities and neglect many rural areas, elderly citizens, and economically disadvantaged
neighborhoods which could benefit the most from ICT upgrades.


We are unique in our corporate commitment to investing in local communities to help eliminate this
Digital Divide.


We are proactively committed to increasing ethnic diversity and MBE/WBE/DBE participation on every
single project we implement – typically exceeding our clients’ goals.


We also work within the Opportunity Zone legislative program, designed to spur economic development
and job creation in distressed communities nationwide, to help maximize the impact of our projects.
 

[Contact Us ][17]

resources for our customers beyond typical lease/bond financing to maximize the size, scope, and
impact of our infrastructure improvements.

financing programs for previous clients, and we can provide the analytical and administrative
support necessary to customize a financing package with multiple components so our clients can
implement the projects they want in the most cost efficient manner possible.

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

## Our mission

How can we **achieve a post-scarcity world** that addresses long-standing problems such as hunger,
poverty, war, pollution and climate change, and sets a new stage for human social development? **By
utilizing science and technology **for the benefit of people and nature. And by **evolving our
outdated cities** into highly automated, interconnected systems with a closed-loop economy.

Implementation includes raising awareness, educating and creating the necessary demand in society,
as well as working on ways to establish research institutes and test sites, promote mass automation,
and use of AI to replace jobs and transform current production/consumption model.

To achieve our goals, we use the ideas first described by the famous futurist Jacque Fresco, which
he called Resource Based Economy, and was widely promoted by the organization The Venus Project
(until 2018) and a number of social movements and initiatives, including ours.

We are committed to the principles of openness, scientific approach, rational thinking and acting
independently of political influences and national boundaries.

[[Now we will be directly involved in the construction of smart cities]][9]

### [Now we will be directly involved in the construction of smart cities][10]

We getting a partnership in the practical realization of a smart city / test site, as well as great
opportunities! We have to start a […]

[Read More][11]
[[Organizing a successful movement]][12]

### [Organizing a successful movement][13]

Our team was formed in 2011 and at the peak there were more than 60 groups in cities in more than 8
countries, and each […]

[Read More][14]

> With the observable fact that scientific knowledge makes our lives better when applied with
> concern for human welfare and environmental protection, there is no question that science and
> technology can produce abundance so that no one has to go without.
> Jacque Fresco

## Let’s keep the direction

Jacque Fresco and The Venus Project gained worldwide recognition with a futuristic vision of a
future based on science and the latest technology that could become a reality. People all over the
world supported the ideas and organized movements, groups, organizations (like ours). All of this
created momentum and helped create a demand in society for these changes.

But since 2020s, thanks to the new directors, the ‘The Venus Project’ organization and its new
program deny the likelihood of achieving this, rewriting the new program on top with the same names,
undermine the credibility of science and medicine, prepare for an apocalypse based on conspiracy
theories of oil shortages, and talk about the need for a rollback in the way of life, the social
system, and even technology. Its build up now on scarcity and solution is a network of eco-villages,
and the salvation ark for some that will be their new planned city in the desert…

*— No, thanks. Let’s maintain the original direction set by Jacque Fresco and move on!*

## **Read the research**
## The END of Jacque Fresco’s The Venus Project:
* [About][15]
* [Introduction][16]
* [Insider’s info][17]
* [Understanding the whole picture][18]
* [Responses][19]

## Is all lost?

It was naive to rely on one single organization for such a global undertaking, which has failed us
many times already. **Now we have to combine all our efforts and do everything as it should be done,
taking this responsibility upon ourselves .**

We have the direction, as well as the knowledge, we have quite feasible projects, many groups,
organizations and hundreds of groups and pages in social networks, as well as the necessary
[experience][20]: from organizing an international decentralized movement, promotion, publishing
books and working with the mass media, conducting interviews and creating media materials, to actual
projects and participating in official events.

We organized and negotiated the building of the city of the future with, then still alive, Jacque
Fresco – and there is still an influential group that wants to move in the proposed direction. Our
partner has already organized a high-level international experience exchange club for real players
in this field, and has plans to build new smart cities and develop this field to Jacques’ proposed
level.

**And this is just one of the possibilities!** We have every chance to do it the way it was needed.
[**Our plan**][21]

With a modest budget, we are making a real difference.
**Join, support, and let’s design our future together!**
The “New Beginnings” Crowdfunding:

[We can do** so much more!**][22]

### [Masterminding Eden: The Venus Project and UFOs. on July 2025][24]

books and working with the mass media, conducting interviews and creating media materials, to actual
projects and participating in official events.

We organized and negotiated the building of the city of the future with, then still alive, Jacque
Fresco – and there is still an influential group that wants to move in the proposed direction. Our
partner has already organized a high-level international experience exchange club for real players
in this field, and has plans to build new smart cities and develop this field to Jacques’ proposed
level.

## Our mission

How can we **achieve a post-scarcity world** that addresses long-standing problems such as hunger,
poverty, war, pollution and climate change, and sets a new stage for human social development? **By
utilizing science and technology **for the benefit of people and nature. And by **evolving our
outdated cities** into highly automated, interconnected systems with a closed-loop economy.

Implementation includes raising awareness, educating and creating the necessary demand in society,
as well as working on ways to establish research institutes and test sites, promote mass automation,
and use of AI to replace jobs and transform current production/consumption model.

To achieve our goals, we use the ideas first described by the famous futurist Jacque Fresco, which
he called Resource Based Economy, and was widely promoted by the organization The Venus Project
(until 2018) and a number of social movements and initiatives, including ours.

We are committed to the principles of openness, scientific approach, rational thinking and acting
independently of political influences and national boundaries.

### Hola! Soy Andrés Sevilla. 

Un chico normal, con una extraña afición.

Desde pequeño he sido un friki de la economía y los mercados. Con tan solo 9 años le quitaba a mi
padre el periódico para leer la sección de economía.

Con lo importante que es la educación financiera nunca entendí por qué hay tan poca información. Así
que en 2012, en mi último año de carrera, me propuse un objetivo claro:

**Hacer fácil la economía para que cualquiera la pueda entender.**

Creé Economipedia para que puedas encontrar cualquier concepto económico, guías de inversión y que
puedas formarte para gestionar tus finanzas y tus inversiones. Sin líos y sin humos. De forma clara
y profesional.

## Lo que nunca te enseñaron.

Después de trabajar durante años como asesor financiero en bancos como BBVA y habiendo alcanzado una
gran independencia financiera, en 2022 decidí dejar mi trabajo para centrarme en la divulgación
financiera y en la formación.

Se sumó al objetivo el gran Carlos Pareja, y junto con él y el resto del equipo que ves en la foto
hemos creado más de 50 cursos de finanzas e inversión.

[[Foto Equipo Economipedia Reducida 1]][25]

Desde entonces han pasado por Economipedia miles de alumnos y hemos probado decenas de formas de
enseñar.

Algunas funcionaron muy bien, y otras no tanto.

Pero todas nos han ayudado a afinar lo que de verdad importa: que sepas por dónde empezar a manejar
tu dinero, invirtiendo con claridad y sacando el máximo partido de tu dinero. Sin complicaciones.

Apúntate abajo y recibe un curso gratuito con las claves para empezar a invertir en bolsa con
cabeza.

## Interested in a Sky-Walker PSIM Software demo?

Good news! Our sales team can't wait to give you a live demo experience of our PSIM software
Sky-Walker.

[ Request your demo today ][91]

### Our areas of expertise

#### Smart Building

It’s an undeniable fact that in recent years the term smart building has become very important. If
you are active in some kind of building, facility, security or safety management business, you’ll
notice the term passing your social media feeds all the time.

[ Learn more ][92]

#### Smart City

Smart Cities are cities that use information technology or the famous 'Internet of Things' to enable
better management of their assets and more efficient governance. An inventive network of sensors and
web applications registers all kinds of data, which may or may not be processed automatically.

[ Learn more ][93]

#### Control Room

Our open integration platform Sky-Walker is mostly used in control rooms. We often get questions
about how control rooms work, and what they are. Even though we are only in charge of providing the
control room software, we do know everything about them. We're happy to share our expertise.

[ Learn more ][94]

## We Build PSIM Software For Your Control Room

Physical Security Information Management doesn't need to be a painful process. With our PSIM
software application called Sky-Walker you can monitor all you security systems from one platform.
We truly believe in building software that matters.

[ Learn more ][95]

### The systems we integrate

#### Security Systems

Security management relates to the physical safety of buildings, people and assets, as well as to
the protection of information, network and telecommunication systems. In today's world,
organizations are increasingly choosing for more, and more intelligent security systems.

[ Learn more ][96]

#### Safety Systems

Sky-Walker connects and integrates any type of safety management system such as fire detection,
sprinklers, intercom, alarm messaging, evacuation systems and safety intake and procedures into an
open, powerful and intuitive user interface.

[ Learn more ][97]

#### Building Systems

Connecting and integrating the separate building systems in one, central monitoring and management
software platform improves building performance, energy efficiency while reducing the operating
costs. Also, the comfort level for the building's inhabitants can improve drastically as well.
Building software that matters for our customers is our primary focus.

[ Learn more ][98]

## Why Choose Our PSIM Software?

With over 30 years of experience in developing PSIM solutions, we became experts in building
reliable and modular security software components. Choosing our PSIM software means easy
installation and configuration, but also low long-term maintenance costs. Together we can build the
software that matters for you!

[ Request demo ][99]

### Our Key Strengths

#### Quick Configuration

With the help of our Configuration Client new projects can get configurated fast and quickly with
ease.

#### ISO Certified

The ISO 27001 standard allows us to meet the requirements relating to the information systems of the
companies we collaborate with.

#### Modular Integration

It doesn't matter what brands our customers use for their security systems. Our software is adaptive
and can connect with anything.

## We Deliver The Best User Experience

All our user interfaces are crafted for the best user experience. Our goal is to limit the support
and training needed to use our application. With the use of intuitive design thinking, new users can
perform basic tasks without any prior training.

[ Learn more ][100]

## Download Our Product Description

Our product description gives you an in-depth overview of what Sky-Walker is and why it can be
important for your business. To stay on top of the latest technology trends we update the product
description every year featuring our latest product build, R&D Innovations, and more.

## Interested in a Sky-Walker PSIM Software demo?

Good news! Our sales team can't wait to give you a live demo experience of our PSIM software
Sky-Walker.

[ Request your demo today ][91]

### Our areas of expertise

#### Smart Building

It’s an undeniable fact that in recent years the term smart building has become very important. If
you are active in some kind of building, facility, security or safety management business, you’ll
notice the term passing your social media feeds all the time.

[ Learn more ][92]

#### Smart City

Smart Cities are cities that use information technology or the famous 'Internet of Things' to enable
better management of their assets and more efficient governance. An inventive network of sensors and
web applications registers all kinds of data, which may or may not be processed automatically.

[ Learn more ][93]

#### Control Room

Our open integration platform Sky-Walker is mostly used in control rooms. We often get questions
about how control rooms work, and what they are. Even though we are only in charge of providing the
control room software, we do know everything about them. We're happy to share our expertise.

[ Learn more ][94]

## We Build PSIM Software For Your Control Room

Physical Security Information Management doesn't need to be a painful process. With our PSIM
software application called Sky-Walker you can monitor all you security systems from one platform.
We truly believe in building software that matters.

[ Learn more ][95]

### The systems we integrate

#### Security Systems

Security management relates to the physical safety of buildings, people and assets, as well as to
the protection of information, network and telecommunication systems. In today's world,
organizations are increasingly choosing for more, and more intelligent security systems.

[ Learn more ][96]

#### Safety Systems

Sky-Walker connects and integrates any type of safety management system such as fire detection,
sprinklers, intercom, alarm messaging, evacuation systems and safety intake and procedures into an
open, powerful and intuitive user interface.

[ Learn more ][97]

#### Building Systems

Connecting and integrating the separate building systems in one, central monitoring and management
software platform improves building performance, energy efficiency while reducing the operating
costs. Also, the comfort level for the building's inhabitants can improve drastically as well.
Building software that matters for our customers is our primary focus.

[ Learn more ][98]

## Why Choose Our PSIM Software?

With over 30 years of experience in developing PSIM solutions, we became experts in building
reliable and modular security software components. Choosing our PSIM software means easy
installation and configuration, but also low long-term maintenance costs. Together we can build the
software that matters for you!

[ Request demo ][99]

### Our Key Strengths

#### Quick Configuration

With the help of our Configuration Client new projects can get configurated fast and quickly with
ease.

#### ISO Certified

The ISO 27001 standard allows us to meet the requirements relating to the information systems of the
companies we collaborate with.

#### Modular Integration

It doesn't matter what brands our customers use for their security systems. Our software is adaptive
and can connect with anything.

## We Deliver The Best User Experience

All our user interfaces are crafted for the best user experience. Our goal is to limit the support
and training needed to use our application. With the use of intuitive design thinking, new users can
perform basic tasks without any prior training.

[ Learn more ][100]

## Download Our Product Description

Our product description gives you an in-depth overview of what Sky-Walker is and why it can be
important for your business. To stay on top of the latest technology trends we update the product
description every year featuring our latest product build, R&D Innovations, and more.

We are a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, making people’s journeys safe,
convenient, and reliable with smart and sustainable people flow.

  Years of experience since KONE was founded in Finland in 1910.
  
  [Illustration of a city with buildings and trees.]
* ### 70
  
  Countries with KONE operations across the globe.

  Employees ready to help you around the world.
  
  [Illustration of a KONE expert working with their computer.]

][141]

At KONE, our purpose is to shape the future of cities. As a global leader in the elevator and
escalator industry, we move two billion people every day, making their journeys safe, convenient,
and reliable with smart and sustainable People Flow®. In 2025, KONE had annual sales of EUR 11.2
billion, and at the end of the year over 60,000 employees, in close to 70 countries. KONE Class B
shares are listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd. in Finland.

Innovation. approach leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence to unlock unparalleled value. By
fusing deep domain specialization with cutting-edge AI, we empower clients in Mobility,
Sustainability, and Tech to accelerate their journey - moving them further, faster, with intelligent
solutions that redefine the next frontiers of technology.

### Mobility

In Mobility segment, we are committed to Engineering Intelligent and Sustainable Mobility for Safer
and Personalized User Experiences. By seamlessly combining digital, AI and physical engineering, we
deliver innovative solutions that redefine how goods and people move. Our Mobility segment
encompasses Automotive, Trucks and Off-highway Vehicles, and Aerospace and Rail.

a Sustainable and Responsible Future. We partner with both upstream and downstream businesses across
the process, plant, and manufacturing sectors - fulfilling the demands of today without compromising
the needs of tomorrow.

  high-protein…

# A propos de Mercuroo

### La société Mercuroo

Nous sommes une société de services indépendante spécialisée en **externalisation d'ingénierie
d'affaires à l'international et de management de contrat export pour les entreprises de la ville
intelligente et durable ou "smart sustainable city"***. 
Avec une expérience cumulée de plus de 30 ans et la réalisation de plus de 150 projets dans le monde
par notre équipe, notre jeune société vous accompagne dans votre développement commercial export et
dans l'exécution de vos contrats export dans le cadre de vos projets smart city.
L'ADN de notre équipe, **immédiatement opérationnelle,** au service de votre réussite et de celle de
vos Clients, se compose des 5 éléments fondamentaux pour mener à bien nos missions:
* **la connaissance technique** par l'expérience/formation
* **le savoir vendre** des produits et solutions
* **le savoir exécuter** des contrats
* **le savoir être flexible**
* **la connaissance** de l'environnement **international**
Nous intervenons auprès de collectivités, d'entreprises et de startups dans les secteurs de la ville
intelligente et durable à la française, des infrastructures de transports terrestres (rail et route)
et de l'ingénierie.

Une ville durable doit avoir une politique de réduction des émissions de Gaz à Effet de Serre (GES)
qui impacte toutes les parties prenantes de la ville. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés comme
**Expert Agréé GCI** auprès de notre partenaire [Global Climate Initiatives][11] pour calculer,
réduire et compenser vos émissions GES.

Nous sommes membre de l’OSCI, les Opérateurs Spécialistes du Commerce International. [L'OSCI][12]
est la fédération des entrepreneurs du commerce international. Elle regroupe les Sociétés
d’Accompagnement à l’International (SAI) et les Sociétés de Commerce International (SCI).

* Pour nous, la "smart sustainable city" est la ville inclusive, solidaire, durable, numérique,
connectée et intelligente. 

# Services

En tant que votre partenaire stratégique en ingénierie d'affaires, nous nous engageons à vous aider
à remporter vos contrats avec une efficacité optimale. Nous accompagnons également l'exécution de
ces contrats, renforçons vos équipes et vous impliquons dans la lutte contre le réchauffement
climatique. Avec un programme sur-mesure, nous travaillons main dans la main avec vous pour un
avenir prospère et durable.

DÉVELOPPEMENT COMMERCIAL

Nous sommes à vos côtés à chaque étape de votre développement commercial en France et à
l'international. Nous nous intégrons harmonieusement à vos équipes, fournissant tous les outils et
soutiens nécessaires à une mise en œuvre efficace et réussie de votre développement commercial en
garnissant votre carnet de commandes.
* Externalisation direction commercial export
* Stratégie commerciale et développement client
* Accompagnement de la prospection à la signature des contrats
* Réponse aux appels d'offres
* Gestion du CRM et du pipeline commercial
* Identification de partenaires
* Ouverture de nouveaux marchés
* Soutien lors de salons internationaux
* Management d'équipe commerciale
* Formation au développement export



Le développement commercial est réalisé par notre pôle

MANAGEMENT DE CONTRAT

Gagner un contrat à forte valeur ajoutée et le manager est complexe, particulièrement à
l'international. Cela nécessite un savoir faire et une exécution professionnelle sans faille. C'est
pourquoi nous intégrons vos équipes en apportant un soutien opérationnel, pour assurer une
réalisation impeccable du contrat.
* Externalisation direction opérationnelle export
* Exécution du contrat jusqu'à la fin de garantie
* Identification de sous traitants
* Coordination d'équipe projet multiculturelle et multidisciplinaire
* Soutien lors de réunion auprès de clients
* Négociation d'avenants
* Gestion de l'ERP et reporting
* Soutien à la rédaction des cahiers de recettes
* Management d'équipe projet
* Formation gestion de contrat export



Le management de contrat est réalisé par notre pôle

BILAN CARBONE / GES

Avec l'appui de notre partenaire Global Climate Initiatives, nous vous accompagnons dans la
réalisation de votre bilan GES (gaz à effet de serre), parmi d'autres services. Nous vous guidons
dans le calcul, la réduction et la compensation de vos émissions GES, affirmant ainsi votre
engagement envers l'environnement.
* Sensibilisation à la neutralité carbone
* Accompagnement bilan GES
* Calcul du bilan GES
* Identification réduction des émissions GES
* Soutien à la compensation des émissions GES
* Reporting bilan GES
* Soutien bilan GES
* Formation bilan GES







﻿


Le bilan carbone est réalisé par Mercuroo Expert Agréé GCI

d'affaires,

# Secteurs

Nous concentrons nos efforts sur des secteurs qui nous inspirent et où l'expertise en ingénierie
d'affaires, notamment export, l'innovation et la technologie sont fréquemment sollicitées. 

VILLE INTELLIGENTE ET DURABLE

(Sustainable Smart City)

Nous accompagnons les entreprises et les collectivités engagées dans la conception de la ville
intelligente et durable de demain, couvrant des domaines clés tels que : la mobilité intelligente,
l'environnement connecté et durable, le cadre de vie innovant, la citoyenneté interactive et les
services publiques digitalisés.

ROUTE

Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec les entreprises spécialisées dans le domaine des
systèmes de péage et de signalisation routière.

INDUSTRIE

Nous intervenons dans toutes les entreprises industrielles B2B, avec une expertise particulière pour
le secteur de la ville intelligente.

RAIL

Nous collaborons activement avec les entreprises spécialisées dans le domaine de la signalisation
ferroviaire, y compris pour le rail, le métro et le tramway.

**INGÉNIERIE**
Nous jouons un rôle actif dans les secteurs de l'infrastructure de transport terrestre (route et
rail) ainsi que dans le domaine de l'aménagement urbain.

# Références

Un large éventail de clients nous fait confiance, couvrant l'ensemble de nos secteurs d'activités.
Ils proviennent de structures diverses, allant des TPE aux PME/PMI, en passant par les ETI, les
grands groupes et les fonds d'investissement. Cette confiance témoigne de notre capacité à répondre
efficacement à une variété de besoins et de défis d'entreprise.

Réaliser une offre différenciante auprès d'une collectivité située aux Etats-Unis



L'objectif principal du directeur commercial de cette société de promotion immobilière est de
répondre aux aspirations d'une petite collectivité écologique, sensible aux enjeux climatiques,
située aux États-Unis. Pour se démarquer de la concurrence, Mercuroo lui propose une solution
novatrice destinée aux futurs propriétaires du projet immobilier : l'autopartage. Une analyse
approfondie du modèle économique faite par Mercuroo est intégrée dans son offre, garantissant ainsi
la pleine satisfaction de son client.



Secteur: smart city/smart mobilité

Accompagnement d'une ETI dans la négociation technico commerciale suite à appel d'offre
international



Cette entreprise de taille intermédiaire (ETI) présélectionnée, se trouve dans une impasse de
négociation pour un projet de plusieurs millions d'euros. Le client de l'ETI menace d'interrompre
les négociations après plusieurs mois de stagnation. Pour surmonter cette impasse, la structure des
coûts de l'entreprise a été soigneusement analysée, conjointement avec l'ingénierie financière. En
résultat, une nouvelle offre commerciale a été formulée et, finalement, acceptée par le client,
redynamisant ainsi les négociations.



Secteur: rail

Lever des réserves de contrats export de la zone Europe et Asie d'une PMI française



Face à des difficultés financières, il est essentiel pour cette entreprise industrielle de taille
intermédiaire de lever toutes les réserves techniques et financières liées aux contrats en cours
dans la zone concernée, pour obtenir les garanties de bonne fin et recevoir les derniers paiements
associés. Une analyse exhaustive de tous les contrats, passifs et réserves a été effectuée. De plus,
un accompagnement dédié dans la mise en œuvre du plan d'action a été assuré pour surmonter ces défis
financiers.





Secteur: route

Accompagner le Directeur Général d'une ETI dans son développement export ﻿



L'objectif principal pour le Directeur Général est d'augmenter le chiffre d'affaires en dehors des
États-Unis de 20%. Pour ce faire, des partenariats sont créés avec les acteurs locaux les plus
influents dans les nouveaux pays ciblés. Des formations sont mises en place pour les équipes, axées
sur la maîtrise de l'anglais et la compréhension des contrats export. De plus, le lancement de
campagnes marketing, incluant des conférences et des salons, est prévu. Enfin, une réduction des
coûts de production est envisagée pour améliorer la compétitivité de l'entreprise sur ces nouveaux
marchés.



Secteur: route

Effectuer un premier bilan carbone dans le cadre d'un appel d'offre pour se différencier



Le défi majeur pour le PDG de cette PME est d'honorer ses engagements en matière de réduction des
émissions de Gaz à Effet de Serre (GES), à la fois vis-à-vis de ses clients et de ses actionnaires.
Lors d'un appel d'offres à l'international émanant de son plus grand client, une collectivité
particulièrement sensible aux enjeux climatiques, et notamment à la pollution atmosphérique, il
entreprend pour la première fois un bilan GES de son entreprise lui permettant de répondre à cet
appel d'offres et explore diverses pistes d'amélioration pour réduire ses émissions GES.



Secteur: smart city/smart environnement

Sensibiliser les équipes d'ingénieur d'affaires export à l'utilisation de CRM



Dans le but d'optimiser la productivité commerciale de la direction de l'ingénierie d'affaires
export d'une entreprise de taille intermédiaire, une formation d'initiation enrichie de retours
d'expérience est proposée. Cette formation se concentre sur les solutions de CRM telles que
Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics et Hubspot, des outils de gestion reconnus pour leur efficacité dans
le domaine de la prospection commerciale et de la gestion de la relation client.









Secteur: rail

Réaliser une pré-étude de marché du secteur de la smart city



Il s'agit d'un véritable défi pour ce fonds britannique qui se voit confier la mission, pour son
client, de formuler une recommandation concernant une diversification dans le secteur de la ville
intelligente (smart city), tout en utilisant une approche anglo-saxonne traditionnelle peu
innovante. Pour ce faire, une étude préliminaire du marché mondial est réalisée. Dans cette étude,
chaque domaine de la ville intelligente est examiné sous l'angle du modèle économique le plus
efficace, servant ainsi de fil conducteur pour l'ensemble de l'analyse.



Secteur: smart city

Formation aux enjeux de la smart city pour un AMO



L'enjeu pour cet Assistant à maitrise d'ouvrage est de savoir donner des réponses à ses clients,
essentiellement des collectivités françaises et étrangères, au concept de la smart city et d'en
mesurer les bénéfices. Les objectifs sont d'obtenir un modèle économique et sociétal pour ses
clients et d'acquérir de la compétence pour la rédaction des cahiers des charges notamment
technique. Enfin la finalité est d'être en mesure de former à l'écosystème smart city.







Secteur: ingénierie

Accompagnement d'un pool de TPE lors de salons à l'international



Ces TPE cherchent à comprendre les enjeux et les perspectives du secteur de la ville intelligente
(smart city) à l'échelle mondiale, tout en cherchant à minimiser leur budget. Pour répondre à ce
besoin, des missions d'accompagnement mutualisées sont organisées suite à une sélection de salons à
visiter sur une année. Ces missions comprennent notamment des visites au CES de Las Vegas, au Smart
City

En tant que votre partenaire stratégique en ingénierie d'affaires, nous nous engageons à vous aider
à remporter vos contrats avec une efficacité optimale. Nous accompagnons également l'exécution de
ces contrats, renforçons vos équipes et vous impliquons dans la lutte contre le réchauffement
climatique. Avec un programme sur-mesure, nous travaillons main dans la main avec vous pour un
avenir prospère et durable.

DÉVELOPPEMENT COMMERCIAL

Nous sommes à vos côtés à chaque étape de votre développement commercial en France et à
l'international. Nous nous intégrons harmonieusement à vos équipes, fournissant tous les outils et
soutiens nécessaires à une mise en œuvre efficace et réussie de votre développement commercial en
garnissant votre carnet de commandes.
* Externalisation direction commercial export
* Stratégie commerciale et développement client
* Accompagnement de la prospection à la signature des contrats
* Réponse aux appels d'offres
* Gestion du CRM et du pipeline commercial
* Identification de partenaires
* Ouverture de nouveaux marchés
* Soutien lors de salons internationaux
* Management d'équipe commerciale
* Formation au développement export



Le développement commercial est réalisé par notre pôle

MANAGEMENT DE CONTRAT

Gagner un contrat à forte valeur ajoutée et le manager est complexe, particulièrement à
l'international. Cela nécessite un savoir faire et une exécution professionnelle sans faille. C'est
pourquoi nous intégrons vos équipes en apportant un soutien opérationnel, pour assurer une
réalisation impeccable du contrat.
* Externalisation direction opérationnelle export
* Exécution du contrat jusqu'à la fin de garantie
* Identification de sous traitants
* Coordination d'équipe projet multiculturelle et multidisciplinaire
* Soutien lors de réunion auprès de clients
* Négociation d'avenants
* Gestion de l'ERP et reporting
* Soutien à la rédaction des cahiers de recettes
* Management d'équipe projet
* Formation gestion de contrat export



Le management de contrat est réalisé par notre pôle

BILAN CARBONE / GES

Avec l'appui de notre partenaire Global Climate Initiatives, nous vous accompagnons dans la
réalisation de votre bilan GES (gaz à effet de serre), parmi d'autres services. Nous vous guidons
dans le calcul, la réduction et la compensation de vos émissions GES, affirmant ainsi votre
engagement envers l'environnement.
* Sensibilisation à la neutralité carbone
* Accompagnement bilan GES
* Calcul du bilan GES
* Identification réduction des émissions GES
* Soutien à la compensation des émissions GES
* Reporting bilan GES
* Soutien bilan GES
* Formation bilan GES







﻿


Le bilan carbone est réalisé par Mercuroo Expert Agréé GCI

# Secteurs

Nous concentrons nos efforts sur des secteurs qui nous inspirent et où l'expertise en ingénierie
d'affaires, notamment export, l'innovation et la technologie sont fréquemment sollicitées. 

VILLE INTELLIGENTE ET DURABLE

(Sustainable Smart City)

Nous accompagnons les entreprises et les collectivités engagées dans la conception de la ville
intelligente et durable de demain, couvrant des domaines clés tels que : la mobilité intelligente,
l'environnement connecté et durable, le cadre de vie innovant, la citoyenneté interactive et les
services publiques digitalisés.

ROUTE

Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec les entreprises spécialisées dans le domaine des
systèmes de péage et de signalisation routière.

INDUSTRIE

Nous intervenons dans toutes les entreprises industrielles B2B, avec une expertise particulière pour
le secteur de la ville intelligente.

RAIL

Nous collaborons activement avec les entreprises spécialisées dans le domaine de la signalisation
ferroviaire, y compris pour le rail, le métro et le tramway.

**INGÉNIERIE**
Nous jouons un rôle actif dans les secteurs de l'infrastructure de transport terrestre (route et
rail) ainsi que dans le domaine de l'aménagement urbain.

# Références

Un large éventail de clients nous fait confiance, couvrant l'ensemble de nos secteurs d'activités.
Ils proviennent de structures diverses, allant des TPE aux PME/PMI, en passant par les ETI, les
grands groupes et les fonds d'investissement. Cette confiance témoigne de notre capacité à répondre
efficacement à une variété de besoins et de défis d'entreprise.

Réaliser une offre différenciante auprès d'une collectivité située aux Etats-Unis



L'objectif principal du directeur commercial de cette société de promotion immobilière est de
répondre aux aspirations d'une petite collectivité écologique, sensible aux enjeux climatiques,
située aux États-Unis. Pour se démarquer de la concurrence, Mercuroo lui propose une solution
novatrice destinée aux futurs propriétaires du projet immobilier : l'autopartage. Une analyse
approfondie du modèle économique faite par Mercuroo est intégrée dans son offre, garantissant ainsi
la pleine satisfaction de son client.



Secteur: smart city/smart mobilité

Accompagnement d'une ETI dans la négociation technico commerciale suite à appel d'offre
international



Cette entreprise de taille intermédiaire (ETI) présélectionnée, se trouve dans une impasse de
négociation pour un projet de plusieurs millions d'euros. Le client de l'ETI menace d'interrompre
les négociations après plusieurs mois de stagnation. Pour surmonter cette impasse, la structure des
coûts de l'entreprise a été soigneusement analysée, conjointement avec l'ingénierie financière. En
résultat, une nouvelle offre commerciale a été formulée et, finalement, acceptée par le client,
redynamisant ainsi les négociations.



Secteur: rail

Lever des réserves de contrats export de la zone Europe et Asie d'une PMI française



Face à des difficultés financières, il est essentiel pour cette entreprise industrielle de taille
intermédiaire de lever toutes les réserves techniques et financières liées aux contrats en cours
dans la zone concernée, pour obtenir les garanties de bonne fin et recevoir les derniers paiements
associés. Une analyse exhaustive de tous les contrats, passifs et réserves a été effectuée. De plus,
un accompagnement dédié dans la mise en œuvre du plan d'action a été assuré pour surmonter ces défis
financiers.





Secteur: route

Accompagner le Directeur Général d'une ETI dans son développement export ﻿



L'objectif principal pour le Directeur Général est d'augmenter le chiffre d'affaires en dehors des
États-Unis de 20%. Pour ce faire, des partenariats sont créés avec les acteurs locaux les plus
influents dans les nouveaux pays ciblés. Des formations sont mises en place pour les équipes, axées
sur la maîtrise de l'anglais et la compréhension des contrats export. De plus, le lancement de
campagnes marketing, incluant des conférences et des salons, est prévu. Enfin, une réduction des
coûts de production est envisagée pour améliorer la compétitivité de l'entreprise sur ces nouveaux
marchés.



Secteur: route

Effectuer un premier bilan carbone dans le cadre d'un appel d'offre pour se différencier



Le défi majeur pour le PDG de cette PME est d'honorer ses engagements en matière de réduction des
émissions de Gaz à Effet de Serre (GES), à la fois vis-à-vis de ses clients et de ses actionnaires.
Lors d'un appel d'offres à l'international émanant de son plus grand client, une collectivité
particulièrement sensible aux enjeux climatiques, et notamment à la pollution atmosphérique, il
entreprend pour la première fois un bilan GES de son entreprise lui permettant de répondre à cet
appel d'offres et explore diverses pistes d'amélioration pour réduire ses émissions GES.



Secteur: smart city/smart environnement

Sensibiliser les équipes d'ingénieur d'affaires export à l'utilisation de CRM



Dans le but d'optimiser la productivité commerciale de la direction de l'ingénierie d'affaires
export d'une entreprise de taille intermédiaire, une formation d'initiation enrichie de retours
d'expérience est proposée. Cette formation se concentre sur les solutions de CRM telles que
Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics et Hubspot, des outils de gestion reconnus pour leur efficacité dans
le domaine de la prospection commerciale et de la gestion de la relation client.









Secteur: rail

Réaliser une pré-étude de marché du secteur de la smart city



Il s'agit d'un véritable défi pour ce fonds britannique qui se voit confier la mission, pour son
client, de formuler une recommandation concernant une diversification dans le secteur de la ville
intelligente (smart city), tout en utilisant une approche anglo-saxonne traditionnelle peu
innovante. Pour ce faire, une étude préliminaire du marché mondial est réalisée. Dans cette étude,
chaque domaine de la ville intelligente est examiné sous l'angle du modèle économique le plus
efficace, servant ainsi de fil conducteur pour l'ensemble de l'analyse.



Secteur: smart city

Formation aux enjeux de la smart city pour un AMO



L'enjeu pour cet Assistant à maitrise d'ouvrage est de savoir donner des réponses à ses clients,
essentiellement des collectivités françaises et étrangères, au concept de la smart city et d'en
mesurer les bénéfices. Les objectifs sont d'obtenir un modèle économique et sociétal pour ses
clients et d'acquérir de la compétence pour la rédaction des cahiers des charges notamment
technique. Enfin la finalité est d'être en mesure de former à l'écosystème smart city.







Secteur: ingénierie

Accompagnement d'un pool de TPE lors de salons à l'international



Ces TPE cherchent à comprendre les enjeux et les perspectives du secteur de la ville intelligente
(smart city) à l'échelle mondiale, tout en cherchant à minimiser leur budget. Pour répondre à ce
besoin, des missions d'accompagnement mutualisées sont organisées suite à une sélection de salons à
visiter sur une année. Ces missions comprennent notamment des visites au CES de Las Vegas, au Smart
City

### ABOUT OUR COMPANY

We are a Tokyo-headquartered, Kathmandu-based firm specializing in market research, venture
building, and 2D/3D animation, committed to delivering excellence in both strategy and creative
production. Our consulting team, composed of Harvard Business School and University of Tokyo
graduates, applies Big 3 (MBB) methodologies to help large organizations, including FORTUNE 500
companies, navigate growth, market entry, product strategy, and operational challenges. Alongside
consulting, our venture-building team drives innovation across eCommerce and HR solutions.

Expanding our offerings, we provide end-to-end animation services, including 2DCG and illustration
for manga, character design, and game/event visuals, 3-view diagrams and color design, 3DCG
production with planning and modeling, and illustrations for merchandise and multimedia content. By
combining strategic insight with creative expertise, we deliver solutions that drive growth,
engagement, and impact—making us a trusted partner for innovation and execution.

## La medida de la prevención

Monitoreo, prevención y Alertamiento 

### Soluciones para monitorear y disminuir riesgos

Diversas soluciones inalambricas basadas en Internet de las Cosas, con una amplia gama de parámetros
ambientales, de proceso y estructurales.

SeismicAlert cuenta con 4 algoritmos de detección, incluyendo onda P; entrega el valor de intensidad
en el sitio sin depender de señales externas.

Proveemos sistemas de monitoreo de Salud estructural para tomar decisiones operativas y evaluar la
integridad y seguridad de la estructura ante sismos.

#### [Monitoreo y desinfección de espacios][20]

Conoce la cantidad de CO2 en tus habitaciones y toma acciones preventivas.

#### [Alertamiento Masivo][21]

Tenemos soluciones de sistemas de advertencia, para notificaciones masivas a todas las industrias,
protección públicos y militares.

#### [Estaciones Meteorológicas][22]

Estaciones para medir y registrar regularmente diversas variables meteorológicas, en el sector de
construcción, energía y otros.

#### [Electricidad][23]

Medidores completamente equipados con opción de modulo LoRa y lectores ópticos altamente compatibles
con casi todos los medidores.

Conoce los radios, routers y concentradores ideales para tus aplicaciones en telecomunicaciones.

# SensorGO

## La medida de la prevención

Monitoreo, prevención y Alertamiento 

### Soluciones para monitorear y disminuir riesgos

#### [Internet de las Cosas][17]

Diversas soluciones inalambricas basadas en Internet de las Cosas, con una amplia gama de parámetros
ambientales, de proceso y estructurales.

#### [Sistema de Alarma Sísmica][18]

SeismicAlert cuenta con 4 algoritmos de detección, incluyendo onda P; entrega el valor de intensidad
en el sitio sin depender de señales externas.

#### [Monitoreo de Salud Estructural ][19]

Proveemos sistemas de monitoreo de Salud estructural para tomar decisiones operativas y evaluar la
integridad y seguridad de la estructura ante sismos.

#### [Monitoreo y desinfección de espacios][20]

Conoce la cantidad de CO2 en tus habitaciones y toma acciones preventivas.

#### [Alertamiento Masivo][21]

Tenemos soluciones de sistemas de advertencia, para notificaciones masivas a todas las industrias,
protección públicos y militares.

#### [Estaciones Meteorológicas][22]

Estaciones para medir y registrar regularmente diversas variables meteorológicas, en el sector de
construcción, energía y otros.

#### [Electricidad][23]

Medidores completamente equipados con opción de modulo LoRa y lectores ópticos altamente compatibles
con casi todos los medidores.

#### [Telemetría][24]

Conoce los radios, routers y concentradores ideales para tus aplicaciones en telecomunicaciones.

## Conoce nuestros sensores y productos

Tenemos una amplia gama de sensores y productos para ayudarte a medir

#### Redes sociales

de eventos, webinars y capacitaciones.

# One group defined by our impact across the built environment.

SJ Group refines and transforms cities into sustainable, liveable environments that uplift the human
experience. Owned by global investment company Temasek, our unique portfolio of companies fuels our
capabilities in building a smart and sustainable future.

Trending
[Design][6] [Digital][7] [Sustainability][8]

## Explore our Worldview
* [World Cities Summit 2026]
  
  ### World Cities Summit 2026
  
  See how we are reimagining cities through Cognitive Cities—combining digital intelligence and
  regenerative design to create cities that work for nature, economies and everyday life.
  
  [ Read more Read more ][9]
* [Singapore International Water Week 2026]
  
  ### Singapore International Water Week 2026
  
  Discover how we help cities and communities strengthen climate resilience through future-ready
  planning, intelligent decision-making and nature-based solutions.
  
  [ Read more Read more ][10]
* [Enriching Lives]
  
  ### Enriching Lives
  
  Across cities and rural communities, the most pressing challenges often go unseen: unsafe housing,
  limited access to clean water, and weak infrastructure that reinforces inequality.
  
  [ Read more Read more ][11]
* [Connecting the World]
  
  ### Connecting the World
  
  Connecting people to opportunities - and goods to markets - requires more than incremental
  upgrades. It calls for a new generation of integrated, resilient transport systems.
  
  [ Read more Read more ][12]
* [Sustainable Development]
  
  ### Sustainable Development
  
  Urbanisation, climate change and resource scarcity are converging to create unprecedented
  challenges. Traditional development models, often focused on short - term gains, have led to
  environmental degradation and social inequalities.
  
  [ Read more Read more ][13]
* [Energy Transformation]
  
  ### Energy Transformation
  
  The global energy system stands at a pivotal moment. As demand for power rises alongside the
  effects of climate change, communities are grappling with a complex energy trilemma: how to
  provide energy that is sustainable, affordable and reliable.
  
  [ Read more Read more ][14]

## Delivering a complete value chain.

At SJ Group, we build bespoke teams for our client's unique needs. Be it a complete turnkey solution
or specific phase of the project, we are here to support with fresh thinking, new approaches and
world-class processes and systems.

  We shape goals, plan projects and help our clients manage complexities.

  We develop plans that shape sustainable communities.
* Design
  
  We push boundaries in design with bold visions, while balancing functional performance.
* Construction
  
  We build, deliver and innovate for seamless delivery.
* Operations
  
  We help enhance asset value and keep up for tomorrow's needs.

## Our Markets

We deliver with experience on the ground,

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

How do I cancel my subscription?

* ## Welcome to the world's leading organization for Smart Cities, Smart Buildings, Strategies,
  ## Policy, Research and Technologies.
  
  **[Learn More][35]**

### Testimonials

Being a member of Smart Cities Council has been singularly one of the most beneficial agreements
I've signed in the last 5 years.  The SCC Leadership and Team has far exceeded our initial
expectations.  I have been able to engage in thought leadership, industry events and been
highlighted across platforms in a way that would have exhausted the limited time, resource and
expertise our early stage personal rapid transit (PRT) would have been able to accomplish on our
own. 

[Andrew J Carey][36], [**SNAAP Transportation**][37]

### Testimonials

The Smart Cities Council ecosystem has been profoundly impactful to Orchestra as it has encouraged
and inspired our growth, expanded our team and introduced advisors we now call dear friends.
Community members, as well as the SCC board, all possess a rare combination: brilliance across
disciplines, unwavering passion for the betterment of humanity, and a spirit of genuine kindness and
integrity. 


SCC not only understands but truly embodies the essence of community. Through that understanding,
and through the exceptional execution of an extraordinarily capable team, the Council continues to
shape the future of cities, and in doing so, the future of humanity itself. 


We are deeply grateful to be part of an organization that so authentically lives its mission and
uplifts all those within its orbit.

[Stephania Stavropoulos][38], [**Orchestra**][39]

[nicole-stephensen]

### Testimonials

This is the place to access best-in-class experts across critical smart cities policy domains - such
as privacy, cybersecurity and data governance. These global and local leaders support SCC members in
identifying and managing risk when leveraging tech and data for public outcomes, and influence the
sector more broadly through SCC forums and collaborative resources.

[Nicole Stephensen][40]

### Testimonials

Smart Cities Council is the international benchmark for smart city/region leadership, collaboration,
and advocacy. Delos Delta is a long-term SCC member, and we get incredible value from SCC's global
events, networks, resources, and connections.

[Brook Dixon][41], [**Delos Delta**][42]

## Our Mission

To create a safer, more beautiful, enabled, resilient, equitable and sustainable world, for
Everyone.

With a global team, Smart Cities Council provides Members and Partners in the Public Sector, Private
Sector and Academia with the education, training, capital, tools, use cases, networks, policies and
advice to set their organizations and projects up for success.
[Join Us][43]

## Join the world's leading network for Smart Cities Technologies and Strategies.

[Join Us][44]

* ## Welcome to the world's leading organization for Smart Cities, Smart Buildings, Strategies,
  ## Policy, Research and Technologies.
  
  **[Learn More][35]**

### Testimonials

Being a member of Smart Cities Council has been singularly one of the most beneficial agreements
I've signed in the last 5 years.  The SCC Leadership and Team has far exceeded our initial
expectations.  I have been able to engage in thought leadership, industry events and been
highlighted across platforms in a way that would have exhausted the limited time, resource and
expertise our early stage personal rapid transit (PRT) would have been able to accomplish on our
own. 

[Andrew J Carey][36], [**SNAAP Transportation**][37]

### Testimonials

The Smart Cities Council ecosystem has been profoundly impactful to Orchestra as it has encouraged
and inspired our growth, expanded our team and introduced advisors we now call dear friends.
Community members, as well as the SCC board, all possess a rare combination: brilliance across
disciplines, unwavering passion for the betterment of humanity, and a spirit of genuine kindness and
integrity. 


SCC not only understands but truly embodies the essence of community. Through that understanding,
and through the exceptional execution of an extraordinarily capable team, the Council continues to
shape the future of cities, and in doing so, the future of humanity itself. 


We are deeply grateful to be part of an organization that so authentically lives its mission and
uplifts all those within its orbit.

[Stephania Stavropoulos][38], [**Orchestra**][39]

[nicole-stephensen]

### Testimonials

This is the place to access best-in-class experts across critical smart cities policy domains - such
as privacy, cybersecurity and data governance. These global and local leaders support SCC members in
identifying and managing risk when leveraging tech and data for public outcomes, and influence the
sector more broadly through SCC forums and collaborative resources.

[Nicole Stephensen][40]

### Testimonials

Smart Cities Council is the international benchmark for smart city/region leadership, collaboration,
and advocacy. Delos Delta is a long-term SCC member, and we get incredible value from SCC's global
events, networks, resources, and connections.

[Brook Dixon][41], [**Delos Delta**][42]

## Our Mission

To create a safer, more beautiful, enabled, resilient, equitable and sustainable world, for
Everyone.

With a global team, Smart Cities Council provides Members and Partners in the Public Sector, Private
Sector and Academia with the education, training, capital, tools, use cases, networks, policies and
advice to set their organizations and projects up for success.
[Join Us][43]

## Join the world's leading network for Smart Cities Technologies and Strategies.

[Join Us][44]

Smart Future Cities India Expo

For the past decade, the Smart Future Cities India expo has endeavoured to build a better future by
showcasing innovation & sustainability. The Smart Future Cities India expo integrates technology
with the key pillars of urban development for optimising resources and making cities smart and
sustainable. The 2026 expo will be a hub for future technologies, with a special focus on Robotics,
Automation, Drones, Cyber Security, Urban Innovation, Smart Mobility, Smart ICT, Greentech and ESG.

The expo will showcase India’s emerging role as a leader in technology and a force for good in the
world. As always, the expo will serve to amplify opportunities and provide a platform to engage with
leaders from government and industry to chart a course for the future. The 2026 expo will focus on
connecting smart city solution providers with senior government officials, industry leaders, Smart
City CEOs, city planners, Mayors, Ambassadors and stakeholders from India and around the globe.
