Smart Future Cities India Expo

For the past decade, the Smart Future Cities India expo has endeavoured to build a better future by
showcasing innovation & sustainability. The Smart Future Cities India expo integrates technology
with the key pillars of urban development for optimising resources and making cities smart and
sustainable. The 2026 expo will be a hub for future technologies, with a special focus on Robotics,
Automation, Drones, Cyber Security, Urban Innovation, Smart Mobility, Smart ICT, Greentech and ESG.

The expo will showcase India’s emerging role as a leader in technology and a force for good in the
world. As always, the expo will serve to amplify opportunities and provide a platform to engage with
leaders from government and industry to chart a course for the future. The 2026 expo will focus on
connecting smart city solution providers with senior government officials, industry leaders, Smart
City CEOs, city planners, Mayors, Ambassadors and stakeholders from India and around the globe.

#### Wearable Devices

Designing wearable sensors that work efficiently in different settings requires engineers and
designers to consider several key factors, including moisture, temperature, use, and more. That’s
because a user's behavior can affect the effectiveness and durability of wearable sensors. Voler
Systems understands how user adoption and their environment can affect the success of the device.
Voler Systems’ engineers are experts in wearable sensors and embedded firmware. We have developed
numerous wearable technology products, particularly ultra-low-power designs featuring sensors and
wireless transmission. We will work closely with you to develop electronic and embedded software for
your wearable device through AI-ready engineering development that supports accurate sensing,
seamless data communication, and reliable performance across real-world environments.

#### Neurological Devices

Designing wearable sensors that work efficiently in different settings requires engineers and
designers to consider several factors including moisture, temperature, use, and more. That’s because
the way a user behaves may affect the wearable sensors’ effectiveness and durability. Voler Systems
understands how user adoption and their environment can affect the success of the device. Voler
Systems’ engineers are experts in wearable sensors and embedded firmware, applying AI-enabled
electronic design to create smarter, more responsive systems. We have developed many wearable
technology products, particularly ultra-low-power designs with sensors and wireless transmission. We
will work closely with you to develop electronic and embedded software for your wearable device.

[IoT Design]

#### IoT Design

Integrating IoT (Internet of Things) into your new product development opens up a huge opportunity
for a more successful and profitable device. However, companies looking to invest in developing IoT
devices often lack the design expertise with sensors, power management, embedded firmware, wireless
communication, and security to guarantee a high-quality final product. Voler Systems provides
**Internet of Things consulting **to help you navigate the complexities of IoT development. We
provide end-to-end support, including sensor integration, power management, and wireless
communication. Our engineers are adept at creating high-quality, secure IoT devices that meet the
demands of today's connected world, using AI-based electronic design to ensure products stay
adaptable as technology and user needs evolve.

#### Embedded Systems

Embedded systems with FPGA offer a flexible, low-risk path to successful system design - boasting
optimum cost efficiencies, and value-added capabilities. These systems combine the power of hardware
acceleration with the flexibility of programmable logic and are well-suited for a wide range of
applications, from industrial automation to IoT devices. Voler Systems excels in **embedded systems
design** for seamless integration with sensors, actuators, and FPGAs, delivering reliable, scalable
solutions tailored to your unique requirements. Our approach includes AI-enabled design to create
intelligent embedded systems that adapt to complex applications and evolving technology needs.

#### Ultra-Low Power

The biggest challenge in a wireless medical device is battery life: how to maximize the length of
time between charges, given the anticipated level of use. A significant factor is the power required
to transmit the necessary data volume over the specified distance. Voler Systems understands how to
combine system design, circuit design, and software to achieve the optimum solution. Our engineers
apply AI-compatible design work to refine power management, extend battery life, and maintain
reliable performance even under demanding conditions. We conserve power by limiting transmission
power, shortening transmission and receive time, using low power sensors, and shutting down unneeded
electronics.

### Creating a Medical, Wearable, or IoT Device?

Since 1979, Voler Systems has been committed to excellence in electronics product design,
specializing in wearable and IoT devices for companies of all sizes that are creating medical and
consumer products. Our engineers have deep knowledge about sensors, wireless communication, power
management for battery-operated devices, and medical devices. This expertise includes AI-enabled
electronics design and AI-based electronic design.

We work closely with you to ensure that every aspect of the design process, from the initial concept
to the final product, is handled with precision and care.

Whether you need an electronic design for medical devices, wearables, or consumer products, our
experienced engineers are here to help you achieve success, mitigating technical risk and making
your product easy to manufacture through forward-looking, AI-ready engineering development that
supports long-term innovation.

#### Medical Devices

Healthcare and technology go hand in hand in delivering better healthcare to patients worldwide. In
fact, remote monitoring went from fringe technology to mainstream usage because it allows doctors to
monitor their patients without a physical visit to the doctor or hospital. Due to the high demand,
companies making these medical devices are overwhelmed. Companies need assistance from expert
electronic design teams specializing in medical IoT and wearable medical technology to develop their
products. Voler Systems has developed hundreds of medical devices up to class III, including
wearable devices, heart pumps, and liquid biopsy platforms. Our expert engineers will help you
design and develop high-quality medical products on budget and on time, so you can get to market
faster. This is supported by AI-assisted engineering, which ensures your products are designed for
the future of intelligent healthcare.

#### Wearable Devices

Designing wearable sensors that work efficiently in different settings requires engineers and
designers to consider several key factors, including moisture, temperature, use, and more. That’s
because a user's behavior can affect the effectiveness and durability of wearable sensors. Voler
Systems understands how user adoption and their environment can affect the success of the device.
Voler Systems’ engineers are experts in wearable sensors and embedded firmware. We have developed
numerous wearable technology products, particularly ultra-low-power designs featuring sensors and
wireless transmission. We will work closely with you to develop electronic and embedded software for
your wearable device through AI-ready engineering development that supports accurate sensing,
seamless data communication, and reliable performance across real-world environments.

Integrating IoT (Internet of Things) into your new product development opens up a huge opportunity

devices often lack the design expertise with sensors, power management, embedded firmware, wireless
communication, and security to guarantee a high-quality final product. Voler Systems provides
**Internet of Things consulting **to help you navigate the complexities of IoT development. We
provide end-to-end support, including sensor integration, power management, and wireless

#### Embedded Systems

Embedded systems with FPGA offer a flexible, low-risk path to successful system design - boasting
optimum cost efficiencies, and value-added capabilities. These systems combine the power of hardware
acceleration with the flexibility of programmable logic and are well-suited for a wide range of
applications, from industrial automation to IoT devices. Voler Systems excels in **embedded systems
design** for seamless integration with sensors, actuators, and FPGAs, delivering reliable, scalable
solutions tailored to your unique requirements. Our approach includes AI-enabled design to create
intelligent embedded systems that adapt to complex applications and evolving technology needs.

#### Ultra-Low Power

The biggest challenge in a wireless medical device is battery life: how to maximize the length of
time between charges, given the anticipated level of use. A significant factor is the power required
to transmit the necessary data volume over the specified distance. Voler Systems understands how to
combine system design, circuit design, and software to achieve the optimum solution. Our engineers
apply AI-compatible design work to refine power management, extend battery life, and maintain
reliable performance even under demanding conditions. We conserve power by limiting transmission
power, shortening transmission and receive time, using low power sensors, and shutting down unneeded
electronics.

FPGAs are available in a range of capabilities and power consumption requirements to suit your

FPGAs and CPLDs. Voler Systems applies AI-driven engineering and extensive experience in developing
**FPGA designs** for medical devices, image and video processing, high-speed memory interfaces,
system integration, architecture development, and design optimization to deliver intelligent,
high-performance solutions.

NB-Fi base stations and devices allow fast deployment of IoT applications and provide the protection
of confidentiality and integrity of transmitted data by strong encryption algorithms.

frequency ranges (ISM radio bands). The NB-Fi Transceiver supports data transfer rate from 50 to

## IoT Solutions

Wireless solutions by WAVIoT are based on the NB-Fi technology that supports secure bidirectional
communication for the Internet of Things (IoT), machine-to-machine (M2M), Smart Grid, Smart
Utilities, Smart City and industrial applications.

WAVIoT base stations and NB-Fi Transceivers with best-in-class receiver sensitivity enable the use
of all advantages of the NB-Fi technology at the same time: long range of bidirectional data
transmission, low power consumption and high scalability and stability of IoT networks.

NB-Fi base stations and devices allow fast deployment of IoT applications and provide the protection
of confidentiality and integrity of transmitted data by strong encryption algorithms.

## Our technology

**NB-Fi** is an LPWAN-class wireless communication technology developed by WAVIoT, which provides
long range communication between devices, both in remote areas and in dense urban environments.
**NB-Fi** technology is at the heart of all our wireless solutions.

NB-Fi is an open standard with a disclosed format of NB-Fi messages and technical data required to
produce compatible IoT devices. NB-Fi can be used in various countries, operating in the unlicensed
frequency ranges (ISM radio bands). The NB-Fi Transceiver supports data transfer rate from 50 to
25,600 bit/s.

* Fast roll-out of NB-Fi network and 100% data collection from IoT devices
* Up to 40 kilometers of NB-Fi network coverage in line of sight
* NB-Fi transceivers and devkits for developers
* NB-Fi transceiver supports 50-25,600 bit/s data rates with exceptional receiving sensitivity up to
  148 dBm
